kol-roi v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches a KOL/creator performance decoder for renewal/ROI using attributed orders and payouts.
- Always outputs a standardized "Creator renewal ledger" table with key metrics and renewal recommendation.
- Enforces explicit treatment of refunds, chargebacks, and suspicious traffic in reporting.
- Includes renewal mini P&L guidance (monthly contribution vs. cost) for recommend vs. pause tiers.
- Provides clear use-case guidance and a template/checklist when data is missing or incomplete.
